name: Seed Development Lifecycle

seed_payload_contract.offspring_identity: new deterministic IndividualSeed + parent pointer; lineage retained

development_semantics.germination: requires sufficient stored seed energy and PH3 coupled net above deterministic threshold
development_semantics.dormancy: chronological age advances while development age remains zero
development_semantics.regrowth: accepted PH2 realizes phenotype again from inherited traits + the seed envelope + local EnvironmentSample
development_semantics.resource_gate: accepted PH3 morphology-resource coupling participates in lifecycle viability/reproduction
development_semantics.reproduction: default P1 genome seed_count produces 80 unique deterministic offspring payloads in the bounded research fixture

research_fixture_boundary: Materializing all 80 offspring payloads is bounded acceptance evidence only. Production ecology remains population-canonical and does not require planet-wide individual GrowthGraph truth.
